test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 9.
solution: The correct answer is 'Before.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence "***___(9)___ I could realize what she was up to...***'' is indicating non-realization of something. • The use of the **past tense** in the sentence indicates the use of the word 'before'. • Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'before'. • The word 'before' means **earlier than the time that**. • Example:* He banged the phone down **before** I could explain*. Hence, the correct answer is option 2. Complete Sentence: *Before I could realize what she was up to...* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us explore the other options: __ • 'No soon' is used **to emphasize the short time in which something happens**. (कम समय जिसमें कुछ होता है) • '**As soon**' means **at the moment (that); when**. (ज्‍यों ही; जब) • 'After' means **later than something; at a later time**. (पश्‍चात; बाद में) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य "*___(9)___ I could realize what she was up to...*'' किसी चीज का एहसास न होने का संकेत दे रहा है। • वाक्य में **भूतकाल** का प्रयोग '**before**' शब्द के प्रयोग को इंगित करता है। • इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त शब्द 'before' है। • 'Before' शब्द का अर्थ है **किसी समय-बिंदु से पहले**। • उदाहरण: *He banged the phone down before I could explain*. अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 है। पूर्ण वाक्य: *Before I could realize what she was up to...* 5a:T1b8d, The correct answer is 'snatched.'
